reviewer: Codex independent offline source and gate reviewer
objective: Review the frozen explicit configured-install-v3 repair for stopped-network placeholders, without operational acceptance or changes to reviewed sources, tests or checkpoint
shown: All six source/test SHA256 values match the frozen checkpoint. This review assesses their current contents, not an inferred clean-checkout diff.

Plan.load requires the explicit companion-configured-install-v3 schema and configured-network-v1 contract, validated unique name/ID mappings, connectivity_verified=false and both startup deferrals false. Legacy schemas cannot acquire nonempty configuration fields or accept blank network IDs.

The pure projection rejects unknown network names, wrong or missing reported IDs and contradictory endpoint/address fields on blank-ID entries. It substitutes only the declared ID and empty IPAMConfig for the separate configuration digest, leaving caller input unchanged.

The backend verifies the complete declared name/ID mapping with bounded network-inspect command construction before projecting selected inventory. Placeholder allowance is restricted to attempt-owned created never-started replacements or exact stopped original applications with preserved image/start/restart history and no attempt label.

Selected raw-observation preservation digests and observed ID tuples remain distinct from configured digests, resolved ID tuples and reported_id/configured_only provenance. The observed audit mismatch remains present; all seven saved configuration projections match their respective original projections.

Aliases, nonempty static IPAM requests, healthchecks, mounts, safety flags and network-mode drift remain visible in the configuration digest. Unknown or conflicting network identities are refused rather than projected away.
Create, disconnect and reconnect commands use the configured full ID rather than a blank observed ID. No start/exec path was added to the installer.

Rollback checks attempt ownership, built image, created state, never-started history and zero restarts before deleting a replacement. Independent v3 probes preserve running, foreign-labeled, previously started, restarted and wrong-image replacements without removal.
Storage snapshots remain exact at installation and rollback postconditions. Independent storage-drift probes cannot produce installation success or verified rollback.

V3 rollback records configuration_restored separately from exact_baseline_restored, exposes rollback_scope=configuration_only and rollback_exact_baseline, and keeps network_connectivity_verified=false. Configured rollback success with a raw mismatch is not labeled exact restoration.

The saved reviewed_stopped_plan loads only under its original v2 contract, with no configured bindings and with startup deferrals preserved. Runtime-policy tests reject all three installation schemas even when other runtime-review fields are valid. No old manifest is promoted or rewritten.

adversarial_probes.launcher: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ./.venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY' ... independent inline assertions ... PY
adversarial_probes.fixture_source: runpy.run_path('tests/test_companion_installer.py') supplies manifest/load, ConfiguredBackend, Receipt and Inline fixtures; independent loops and assertions exercise these and the production projection/mapping methods
adversarial_probes.transport_guards: socket connect/connect_ex/getaddrinfo, subprocess.Popen and the real DockerInstallBackend._command were replaced with immediate assertion failures; per-instance command stubs return only synthetic mapping JSON
case_details: Compare seven saved before/after projections without modifying either input; separately assert the audit preservation digest still differs.
Reject wrong, absent and null NetworkID, an added unknown network name, and each nonempty EndpointID/IPAddress/IPv6Address/GlobalIPv6Address/Gateway/IPv6Gateway on a blank-ID row.
Require different configuration digests for alias replacement, alias addition, healthcheck/mount/safety/network-mode drift and nonempty IPv4Address/IPv6Address/LinkLocalIPs/unknown-key IPAM requests.
For each v1/v2 schema, refuse a network_contract, each nonempty configured snapshot field, and a blank observed network ID.
Mutate the first v3 replacement during source verification to running, foreign-labeled, previously started, restarted or wrong-image; require incomplete installation/rollback and no remove call.
Mutate a storage metadata digest during the final source verification, once returning true and once false; require neither installation nor rollback acceptance and an exact-baseline mismatch.
Stub daemon mapping responses as absent, wrong name, wrong ID or duplicated row; require refusal in every case.

Fail rename/disconnect/create/verify_sources before and after effects in the v3 fake backend; require successful configuration rollback, no surviving attempt objects, exact storage and false startup/connectivity authorization.
Hash-load the saved original v2 plan; require empty configured bindings, unchanged v2 schema and both startup deferrals.

claimed: Checkpoint reports a parent focused run of 396 passed in 2.70s; the independent run above, not that report, is this review's local test proof.
unverified: No actual daemon acceptance, live placeholder behavior, effective endpoint attachment, DNS, routing or connectivity is established by these configuration projections or simulated commands.
No installation, operational retry, private configuration transfer, storage-content inspection, service startup, runtime policy completion or full-system readiness is reviewed or authorized.
The historical recovery remains INCOMPLETE; this source-only decision does not change its recorded exact-restoration outcome.
remaining_risks: The configuration digest is deliberately weaker than exact historical observed metadata. The existing raw preservation digest is itself a selected-field digest, not a byte-for-byte hash of the complete daemon payload; endpoint/address changes and unselected metadata are not new network proof.

The declared mapping is checked against the daemon by code, but only stubbed responses were tested here. Future operational use still requires freshly observed mapping/baseline evidence and separately reviewed expected v3 configuration fingerprints.

Inventory, identity checks and lifecycle commands are not an atomic transaction. Trusted local inputs and quiescent external lifecycle writers remain operational prerequisites; no new concurrent-writer guarantee is certified.
Exact storage proof here means equality of selected Snapshot fields, not filesystem/database content integrity.
A green focused suite and source-only acceptance do not authorize operations or satisfy the deferred startup policies.
proof_required_next: Before any future operation, independently review a new explicit v3 manifest bound to a fresh raw baseline, verified name/ID mappings, separately derived expected configuration digests, reviewed source hashes and unchanged false startup deferrals.

Obtain separate explicit installation authorization; this review grants none. Effective networking and any later startup require their own evidence and authorization, not a configured-only digest or reuse of an old manifest.
